data.comment:
Sequencing decision (producer, this session): Option C (F9 CG-0MUH0NTRG007GDME) is to be completed BEFORE the nine `tce-*` GitHub remotes are created, not after.

Order: F5 (done) -> F9/C1..C4 (settle the per-game src/ layout) -> create the nine remotes -> F7 integration verification.

Reason: F9 changes the extraction/scaffold output that F4 produces, so the repos should be created once in their final layout rather than re-extracted/re-pushed afterwards. F9 depends-on F5; F7 depends-on F9. Repo creation remains unauthorised (F4 producer gate) and is not yet a work item; when raised it belongs between F9 and F7.

data.comment:
Sequencing decision (producer, this session): Option C lands BEFORE the nine `tce-*` GitHub remotes are created. Sequence is F5 (done) -> F9/C1..C4 -> create the nine remotes -> F7 integration verification.

Rationale: C3 changes what scripts/extract-repos.sh + game-repo-scaffold.ts emit (the per-game layout), so F4's output must be settled before any remote is created. Creating remotes first would force a re-extract/re-scaffold/re-push of already-created repos with history-rewrite risk. Creating them once, after C1..C4, produces them in the final src/ shape.

Graph as wired: F9 depends-on F5 (CG-0MTRO77XA006YZZC); F7 (CG-0MTRO7ECL006ID7J) depends-on F9. Repo creation is a separate future step (currently NOT authorised by the F4 producer gate) and has no work item yet; when it is created it should sit between F9 and F7 (i.e. F7 also depends-on it). No F9 -> repo-creation edge is added, so F9 is startable now against the local scaffolds.
